title: I've created a game: Chronicles of the Dying - Anthology
author: railmc
selftext:
Hello, 

My name is railmc and I am a product manager for a softwarecompany. Meaning that I work with developers but do not develop myself nor am I able to. Neither do I draw or compose.

I've made a non-commercial game (you cannot spend money on it in any way and it does not contain any type of money-making mechanisms like ads or donation buttons).

All graphics, music, voice acting and coding have been done with AI.

I used Cursor (mostly running on Auto, sometimes on Opus and most recently on Grok) running on Pro+ for 60 Euros a month

The game is client-server and completely in React/Typescript with postgres SQL

The music has been made in Suno (v5.5) which I only subscribed to for one month to make all music I needed.

Graphics I made with [Leonardo.ai](http://leonardo.ai/) (mostly Nano Banana and GPT) for 30 Euros a month.

Voice acting is ElevenLabs which I am still subscribed to because I still have the campaign ahead of me.

Story, order design (including balancing) and game modes I made without AI.

I am about 1000 hours in. This is mostly planning, storytelling, playtesting and bugfixing.

Over 8000 matches have been played so far by a total of \~60 accounts created. Most PvE. Only about 300 have been PvP.

If you want to check it out, you can either play it online (but I did not optimize the performace for this) Or install it locally. Both options can be found on [https://chronicles-of-the-dying.com/](https://chronicles-of-the-dying.com/)

I would recommend the 4 tutorial missions and then an Explore the Unknown run. After that you should have a clear overview and know whether its for you or not. It will take you about 30 minutes I think.

I am very proud of it and actually play it a lot myself but its very hard to get people to give it a try because of its heavy AI use.

If you are interested in PvP ist best to add me as a friend ingame. My name is railmc. I am on my lunch break but I will be online in about 5 hours or so.

replies.author: railmc
replies.body:
Thank you for this feedback. I do not think I will change it again because its thousands of graphics but at least I have a better idea what the problem is. Basically I was tricked into thinking "you do not need to be good at art anymore to create a good game". But thats still not true looks like.  
Hoenstly I assume thats not a bad thing but sure, I would have liked to share my game with someone all the same.

replies.author: OrganizationLow5701
replies.body: You do not need good art for a good game - TRUE, but devs compensate that by having a fun gameplay loop, which looking at your game doesnt catch my interest, just giving feedback. Also the amount of art pictures being shown doesnt really add much to the trailer i think.

replies.author: railmc
replies.body: I had the same fear but decided to leave them in. Its my first trailer so it is not all that surprising that its more miss than hit.

comments.author: completelypositive
comments.body:
Steam new game list is too big now. A year ago you could find new games easily. Too many low quality effort AI games to sort through. 

Your game looks identical to the 300+ new games that steam listed yesterday. It is nearly indistinguishable from hundreds of other games that came out this week.

replies.author: railmc
replies.body: You are making a good point. Thank you for this. I think I come from an era of content creation where the internet was much more forgiving :D
